Title: Public Preview: Configure customer-managed keys on existing Cosmos DB accounts

Body.Content:
We are pleased to announce that you can now enable Customer Managed Keys (CMK) on existing Azure Cosmos DB accounts. This eliminates the need to migrate data to a new account to enable CMK.

This release follows the existing ability to enable a second layer of encryption for data at rest using CMK while creating a new Azure Cosmos DB account.

Using these features can help you to improve your security and compliance posture.

 

Learn More:

  • Configure customer-managed keys for your existing Azure Cosmos DB accounts! - Azure Cosmos DB Blog (microsoft.com)
  • Configure customer-managed keys on existing accounts - Azure Cosmos DB | Microsoft Learn
